args.summary: Built and checked a 2D spine-beam OpenSeesPy model for a four-span (30+42+42+30 m) cast-in-place continuous prestressed box girder, with twin-column piers, the described sliding/fixed laminated bearings, and JTG D60-2015 Class I one-way three-lane loading. Main girder section A=6.79 m², I=4.2175 m⁴; self-weight=176.54 kN/m. Modal vertical frequencies are 3.114, 4.328, and 6.184 Hz; impact factor μ=0.1850. Model generation passed the KG L1 topology, L2 code, and L3 mechanics checks. Computed self-weight peak midspan moment was 13,821 kN·m and peak negative support moment was −27,770 kN·m; lane-load moment extrema were +10,522 and −8,655 kN·m.
